title: HChar-Grilled Snappy Semolina Flatbread Iron-Teppan
description: A funky, snappy, cozy Slovakian dish featuring semolina flour, char-grill-yang and jain-friendly. Vessel: iron-teppan.
instructions: Mix together yeast and water in a large bowl.
Add semolina flour, salt, and olive oil to the mixture.
Knead dough for about 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover and let rise at room temperature for 45 minutes.
Preheat your iron-teppan on medium-high heat.
On a floured surface, roll out dough into a thin round shape.
Place the dough directly onto the hot teppan without rolling again.
Cook for about 2-3 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
Serve immediately with your favorite toppings.
